## Organisation
Blue Bayou Water Park and Dixie Landin' Theme Park are two sister parks operated together under the name Blue Bayou / Dixie Landin'.

![](images/5ac7848a651905ef6f4faf47-Blue%20Bayou%20Logo.svg)
Blue Bayou Waterpark page: /park/blue-bayou-waterpark

![](images/5ac7848eb01ca6b73a0416bd-Dixie%20Landin%20Logo.svg)
Dixie Landin' page: /park/dixie-landin

## Navigation links
- Home: /
- Attractions
- Tickets
- Plan, including Calendar (/calendar) and Jobs (/jobs)
- Parks: Park Maps (/plan#maps), Dixie Landin' (/park/dixie-landin), Blue Bayou Waterpark (/park/blue-bayou-waterpark)
- Plan: Directions (https://goo.gl/maps/BeXNMkjSzdB2), Food & Concessions (/plan#food), Hotels (/plan#hotels), Corporate Events (/plan#events), Birthday parties (/plan#birthdays), Groups (/plan#groups), Calendar (/calendar)
- Tickets: Buy Tickets (/pricing), Season Passes (https://www.etix.com/ticket/v/12750/blue-bayou-waterpark-and-dixie-landin)
- More: Contact (/contact), Jobs (/jobs), FAQs (/faq)

## Opening announcement
Opening Day: May 29, 2021. Because of recent weather and the forecast for the following week, Blue Bayou Water Park is pushing back its opening to May 29, 2021 at 10:00 a.m. The park hopes to welcome guests, their families and friends during the summer.

## Tagline
"Play Your Day Away"

![](images/5ac7aeee2c10d19f9542cd3e-shutterstock.jpg)
![](images/5ae7932d8423ad969fcdd23d-DL.jpg)
![](images/5ac7aaaee4871dbdac640078-brush.svg)

## Quick actions
- Buy Tickets, with the call to action "Start the Excitement" (/pricing)
- Season Passes, with the call to action "More fun for Everyone" (https://www.etix.com/ticket/v/12750/blue-bayou-waterpark-and-dixie-landin)
- Birthday parties, with the call to action "Celebrate with us" (/plan#birthdays)

## Blue Bayou Waterpark: "Enter the Land of the Giants"
![](images/5ae8775a41c7120f2ade82e5-landofthegiants.jpg)
Visitors are invited to bring their floaties, apply sunscreen and bring the whole family for a fun summer escape in the sun.
Calls to action: Get a Season Pass (https://www.etix.com/ticket/v/12750/blue-bayou-waterpark-and-dixie-landin) or Buy Tickets (/pricing).

## Dixie Landin' Theme Park: "Experience the Thrills"
![](images/5ada2848fcceb9441ecf15ea-Thrills.jpg)
Because of Covid-19, Dixie Landin' Theme Park stays closed for the whole 2021 season. It plans to return in 2022.
Calls to action: Get a Season Pass (https://www.etix.com/ticket/v/12750/blue-bayou-waterpark-and-dixie-landin) or Buy Tickets (/pricing).

## Summer messaging
![](images/5ac7c16eb01ca614b50476f0-stencil-summeriswaiting.png)
![](images/5ac7c110e4871d29e0642b45-shutterstock.jpg)
The message "Summer is waiting" accompanies these images.

## Stay connected
Follow on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/Blue-Bayou-Dixie-Landin-200868959959549/) or subscribe to the newsletter (/subscribe).
Other social profiles: Twitter (https://twitter.com/bluebayoudixie/), YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/user/BlueBayouBR?feature=mhee).

## Plan Your Summer Getaway
![](images/5ac7cee6e4871debb6643d2f-shutterstock.jpg)
Planning resources: Park Maps (/plan#maps), Directions (https://goo.gl/maps/BeXNMkjSzdB2), Food & Concessions (/plan#food), Groups (/plan#groups), Hotels (/plan#hotels), Corporate Events (/plan#events).
Calls to action: Get a Season Pass (https://www.etix.com/ticket/v/12750/blue-bayou-waterpark-and-dixie-landin) or Buy Tickets (/pricing).

## Return-visit policy
Guests who pay the full daily admission price and have their ticket validated before leaving that day can come back the following day for free, as long as that second day is not a Saturday.

## Coca-Cola promotion
![](images/5ac79fd0af4ae8b8ce2f33d6-coke-white.png)
![](images/5ac7a77999758e48291d6171-coke-can-full.png)
Save $5 when presenting any Coca-Cola can.

## Legal
© Blue Bayou / Dixie Landin'. All Rights Reserved.

I built the site as a single page at `index.html` in the project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the mobile menu are untested.

- **Header and announcement:** a sticky bar with both park logos and the nav from the brief (dropdowns for Tickets, Parks, Plan and More, collapsing to a menu button on phones). The May 29, 2021 opening notice sits below it.
- **Hero:** "Play Your Day Away" over the waterslide photo, with the white brush-stroke graphic as the torn edge at the bottom.
- **Quick actions:** the three cards (Start the Excitement, More fun for Everyone, Celebrate with us).
- **Park cards:** the two parks side by side, with Dixie Landin' marked "Closed for 2021 · Returning 2022".
- **Summer banner:** the "Summer is waiting" stencil over the second photo.
- **Stay Connected:** Facebook, newsletter, Twitter and YouTube links.
- **Plan Your Summer Getaway:** the planning links next to the third photo.
- **Perks:** the return-visit policy and the Coca-Cola $5 offer.
- **Footer:** the legal line and a few links.

- **Logo filenames:** the two logo files have a literal `%20` in their names. The page references them as `%2520` so they load, so don't rename them without updating those links.
- **Internal links:** paths like `/pricing` and `/plan#food` are used exactly as in the brief. They only work once the page is served from the site root, not when opened from a file.
- **Extra links:** `/attractions` and `/subscribe` aren't given a path in the brief for Attractions and the newsletter. I guessed those two. The Plan menu also lists Calendar and Jobs.
